architecture.premise: Models and other software call the same operations without a human screen.
architecture.requirement: One domain service layer, MCP as the model transport, a Python SDK on those same functions, holds preserved.
architecture.decision: Do not relocate src or instruments. Tests and pins import those paths. ciw.services is the application service. MCP tools delegate to it.
architecture.assumption_resolved: Vendored instruments are not the leakage or BIM checkout. Unbound engines stay blocked rather than simulated.
